'''Noop Yeldarb''' was an elderly [[Human/Legends|Human]] man from [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] who maintained the [[lightstation]] in the [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|Cloak of the Sith]]. Although most of the lightstations scattered throughout the nebula were autonomous, it was Yeldarb's duty&mdash;along with the Roon Trade Guild&mdash;to ensure that pirates would not interfere with the lightstations' positions and draw unsuspecting travelers into a trap. The responsibility had been forced upon him by the nefarious [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]], who had enslaved many [[Mudman|natives]] of Roon.

It was during Yeldarb's tenure aboard the [[Umboo lightstation|Umboo Lightstation]] that [[Mungo Baobab]]'s ''[[Caravel (starship)|Caravel]]'' was intercepted and captured by Koong, mistaking the explorer for [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]]. With Baobab's help, Yeldarb was able to escape the governor's grip and, in grateful return, point the treasure-hunter and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companions, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], in the direction of the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]].

Following Koong's death, Yeldarb returned to the Umboo Lightstation and resumed his duties.
